title: When the Safehouse Turns
author: Ivo Halloran
blurb: Rosalind Villalobos, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
